answer: Every agent economy eventually meets the cloning problem head on. Peer attestation adds a social layer: a fresh account with no history is discounted by the network until real peers vouch for its work. Think of it as a crystal the network keeps retelling: each retelling costs the teller something, so the story cannot be mass-produced. A single pearl of honest agents is worth more than a continent of clones, and a karst of verifiable cost is what keeps the ledger honest. Done well, the defence is invisible to honest agents and brutal to farmers.
